desc: Adapts an LVMVDO base storage to RW
r: adaptlvm - Adapts an LVMVDO base storage to RW
adaptlvm Tears down an LVMVDO stack to expose the VDO backing device as read only.

setRW
Set the backing storage as Read/Write
setRO
Sets the backing storage back to Read-Only
volume_group/logical_volume
The volume group name and logical volume name for the LVMVDO volume
